description: Land Title Settlement Department - Inamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District  - Cad. Map No. 310009
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details (primarily "The State"), and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
